description: This file contains utility functions for managing GPU streams, events, and synchronization within PyTorch's _functorch and FX graph framework. It includes methods for estimating runtime, inserting synchronization points, handling stream timelines, and managing backward passes and deallocations.

methods.name: float get_roofline_estimate(node: Node)
methods.description: Estimates the roofline performance metric for a given FX Node based on transfer and compute times.

methods.name: bool is_gradient_acc(node: Node)
methods.description: Checks if a node is a gradient accumulation node based on its metadata.

methods.name: bool is_bwd_node(node: Node)
methods.description: Determines if a node is a backward node by examining its partitioner tag in metadata.

methods.name: torch.device get_device(node: Node)
methods.description: Retrieves the device associated with a node's value.

methods.name: Optional[int] get_stream(node: Node)
methods.description: Retrieves the stream index annotation from a node's metadata, if present.

methods.name: int get_stream_or_current_stream(node: Node)
methods.description: Returns the stream index from the node or defaults to the current stream for the device.

methods.name: None set_stream(node: Node, ind: int)
methods.description: Sets the stream index annotation in a node's metadata.

methods.name: Node insert_record_event_after_node(graph: Graph, node: Node, event_ind: int)
methods.description: Inserts a record_event node after a specified node in the graph with a given event index.

methods.name: Node insert_wait_event_before_node(graph: Graph, node: Node, event_ind: int)
methods.description: Inserts a wait_event node before a specified node in the graph with a given event index.

methods.name: IndexedDict[Node,float] populate_stream_timeline( stream_to_timeline: dict[Optional[int], IndexedDict[Node, float]], graph: Graph, stream_index: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Populates a timeline map with the cumulative estimated execution time per node for a given stream.

methods.name: None handle_synced_deallocation( graph: Graph, stream_to_exec_trace: dict[Optional[int], IndexedDict[Node, float]], node: Node, last_usage: Node, )
methods.description: Handles synchronized deallocation of tensors across streams by inserting appropriate events and synchronization nodes.

methods.name: None insert_sync( graph: Graph, consumer: Node, producer: Node, node_to_wait_event_ind: dict[Node, int], )
methods.description: Inserts synchronization between producer and consumer nodes if they are on different streams.

methods.name: None assign_backward_streams(gm: torch.fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Assigns backward streams to gradient accumulation nodes based on their users and arguments.

methods.name: None insert_backward_syncs(gm: torch.fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Inserts stream synchronization points between backward nodes and their arguments where necessary.

methods.name: None sync_deallocations(gm: torch.fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Handles the process of recording streams and deallocating tensors at the appropriate points.

methods.name: assign_epilogue_copy_streams(gm: torch.fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Sets stream annotations for in-place copy operations at the end of forward passes.

methods.name: populate_fw_metadata_with_stream_indices( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, fw_metadata: "ViewAndMutationMeta" )
methods.description: Extracts and populates stream indices from the graph's output nodes into metadata for mutated inputs.
